# Build pipeline and generated files

Reference for what is generated, from what, and which command refreshes it. Moved out of CLAUDE.md 2026-10-16. Never hand-edit a generated file.

- `data.py` — single source of truth for every macro. Edit macros HERE only.
- `template.html` — HTML/CSS/JS shell (shared top bar + macro cheatsheet UI);
  `__DATA__` is replaced with the macro JSON at build time, `__PAGE_MACROS__` /
  `__PAGE_BUILDS__` / `__PAGE_ADDONS__` / `__PAGE_LAUNCH__` are replaced with `aria-current="page"` markers.
  Each macro-type group (Damage/offensive, Wand, etc.) renders as a "tabbed picker":
  a row of pill buttons (one per macro in that group) plus a single code panel below
  that swaps when a pill is clicked, styled after warcrafttavern.com/forever's macro
  guide layout. Search results still use the old always-expanded list style
  (`groupHTML`/`details.section`), since search spans multiple classes/groups at once.
  Also holds the addon **export mode** ("Export macros" toggle, checkboxes,
  export tray, `R2F1:` import string, selection in localStorage `wf-export-v1`);
  spec and build decisions in `ADDON_PLAN.md` sections 4 and 7.
- `build.py` — generates `macros.html` and `wow-forever-macros.md` from `data.py` +
  `template.html`, then runs `addon/tools/gen_plan_data.js` (node) which writes the addon's
  `addon/RoadToForever/PlanData.lua` from `launch-plan.html` (RACES, CLASSES, PRESETS and its resolve functions),
  `launch-plan-steps.json` (the steps) and `launch-plan-waypoints.json` (waypoints for the in-game Plan tab, ADDON_PLAN 15.5; per-race lists: skyborne, dwarf, gnome, human, nightelf). Never
  hand-edit `PlanData.lua`; after changing launch-plan.html's RACES/CLASSES/PRESETS, `launch-plan-steps.json` or the waypoints JSON,
  run `python build.py` (the addon tests fail if it is stale). The same run validates `launch-plan-steps.json`
  (`node addon/tools/gen_plan_data.js --validate`: unique ids, known races / classes / presets, lvl and title present, every
  phase has a section on the page; it fails the build and CI). To prove an edit to the plan data changed only what you meant:
  `node tools/plan_snapshot.js > before.json` before, `node tools/plan_snapshot.js --check before.json` after
  (every step of every phase for every race / class plan; `--html` / `--steps` read older copies).
- Site checks you can run any time (no network needed):
  - `python tools/check_links.py` — every href / src / fetch target exists, every `#anchor` and hash route (`bis.html#hunter/survival`, `professions.html#bis/<class>`, `talents.html#<class>` / `#legacy`) resolves, every `launch-plan.html?plan=` / `?race=&class=` / `?level=` / `?mode=` value is real (and a race can be that class), ids are unique per page, manifest icons exist. CI runs it in `site-checks.yml`. `--external` also asks each outside URL once and prints warnings only.
  - `node tools/rehearse.js` — launch-day rehearsal in headless Chrome with a faked clock (`--quick`, `--only pages|countdown|plans|night|bis`): all pages load without script errors and with matching top bars, the Home countdown at T-2d, T-1h, T-1s and after launch, all 29 launch plans draw exactly the steps `plan_snapshot.js` resolves, night mode, every Mr.BiZ spec, and an accessibility audit of every page (desktop and phone: names on links and buttons, alt text, form labels, text contrast 4.5:1 / 3:1 large, tap targets at least 24px, `main` landmark, one `h1`, heading order, `noopener`; `--only a11y --report` lists every finding; `--eval <page> "<function source>"` inspects one thing in a page). About a minute. `Rehearsal` in the Actions tab runs it on demand (not on push). It prints a NOTE when Home still carries the Beta ribbon after launch. Set `CHROME=` if Chrome is not found.
- `addon/RoadToForever/MacroData.lua` — GENERATED by `build.py` from `data.py`: every macro as one `R2F1:` import string
  (byte-identical to the site's export tray with everything ticked; the addon tests compare it with the page's own JS).
  `Bundle.lua` installs it at login once per `version` (hash), through the normal Import path. Never hand-edit; after any
  `data.py` change run `python build.py` (`python build.py --check-macro-data` = exit 1 if stale; the addon tests run it).
  A macro change therefore needs an addon release to reach players in game.
- `macros.html`, `wow-forever-macros.md` — generated output. Never hand-edit; run
  `python build.py`.

- `bis/` — Mr.BiZ data. `bis/raw/levels/<class>-<spec>.json` = ForeverDB's BiS pages for that spec at every level 10-60 (PvE), as runs of
  levels with the same pick, one file per spec (27; Feral = "Feral (Bear)", ForeverDB weights it for tanking); refresh steps in `bis/README.md`
  (`foreverdb_levels.py`, `foreverdb_segments.py`). `bis-data.json` and `BiZData.lua` keep per spec and slot the runs `[from, best row, [next rows]]`
  plus one shared `rows` table; `bis.html` (`slotsAt`) and `BiZ.lua` (`BiZ.SlotsAt`, `spec.slots` follows `BiZ.Level()`) resolve them for one level.
  `python bis/build_bis.py` parses each source
  sentence (type, label, group, profession / skill, instance, drop %, faction) and writes `bis-data.json` +
  `addon/RoadToForever/BiZData.lua`; `--check` = exit 1 if stale (the addon tests run it). `build.py` runs it too.
  `bis/sources.json` = sources for rank 2-3 picks that are no spec's best pick (ForeverDB item pages, same sentence
  wording as the BiS pages); the build stops if a next pick has no source. `bis/places.json` = where a source is
  (dungeon entrance by instance name, vendor by name, reputation by faction; zone + x/y + conf like the plan
  waypoints) for the addon's BiZNav arrow: the build adds `place` to matching rows and a `places` table to both outputs,
  and stops on a place no row uses. Enchants: the build also reads professions.html's `DATA` (BiS enchants, via
  `node bis/enchants_from_professions.js`) and adds `enchants` (per gear slot) + `enchantPage` to every spec, using
  `ENCHANT_PAGE` (our spec -> ForeverChanges page name, always a PvE page; Feral = Druid Tank, Fury = Warrior Arms,
  Subtlety = Rogue Combat, Discipline = Priest Holy) and `ENCHANT_SLOTS`; it stops on an unknown slot or page. So an
  enchant edit on professions.html needs `python bis/build_bis.py` (the addon tests catch a stale BiZData). bis.html
  shows them as an "Enchant:" line in an opened row (links to professions.html#bis/<class>), the addon under a slot's
  picks. Item rarity is baked in (owner, 2026-10-13): `bis/quality.json` (`{quality: {id: 0-5}}`, written by `bis/tools/items_build.py` from the WCLBox item list) -> a top-level `quality`
  table in both outputs; bis.html's `whLink` and the addon's `BiZ.Quality` use it when the live lookup has nothing
  (the live lookups stay as they were). The build only notes ids missing from the file; refresh it when items
  change (run `python bis/tools/items_build.py` after `build.py`, then `build.py` again for the new ids; it reads the WCLBox cache).
  Item table (2026-11-13): `bis/items.json` is built from WCLBox, not from the client DB2 tables: `python bis/tools/wclbox_pull.py` fills the
  gitignored cache `bis/own/cache/wclbox/` (list + detail of every weapon and armor, about 70-150 minutes at 1 request per second; `--keep-cache`
  finishes the cached build even if WCLBox moved on), `bis/tools/wcl_parse.py` turns a tooltip into a record, `items_build.py` writes the table,
  `bis/tools/wclbox_diff.py` compares a pull with the previous table (`bis/own/wclbox-diff.md`). Note: `build_bis.py` does not read `items.json`;
  Mr.BiZ picks come from ForeverDB. `ah-items.json` (Auction House fallback) is built by `tools/build_ah_items.py` from the same WCLBox list and
  left untouched when the cache is missing. Refreshing the data: `bis/README.md`. New source wording that the parser doesn't know raises an error on purpose:
  add a rule to `parse_source`, don't hand-edit the outputs.

- `addon/art/` — the addon's art pipeline: `export_arrow3d.py` renders the waypoint arrow looks in Blender into `media/arrow3d*.tga` sprite sheets
  (models `blender_arrow3d*.py`, shared `blender_arrow_parts.py` / `blender_arrow_render.py`, painted pictures via `make_image_looks.py` +
  `sources/`), `export_arrow.py` the flat dart, `export_logo.py` the logo. Details in ADDON_PLAN section 21. Release = all checks green first.

- `ADDON_PLAN.md` — plan for the "Road to Forever" in-game addon (macro import,
  talent import/export, minimap button, Plan, BiS, arrow; built; see addon/RoadToForever/README.md). Read it before touching
  anything addon-related, the `short`/`icon` macro fields, or the talent link format.

## Quest weapons (launch plan, site and addon)
`bis/build_quest_weapons.py` (run by `build.py`) reads `bis/quest-weapons.json` and writes `addon/RoadToForever/QuestWeaponData.lua`
and `launch-plan-weapons.json`. Never hand-edit either. `CLASS_USE` in that script is the one class weapon table; both outputs
carry it. The addon scores upgrades against the worn gear; the site cannot, so it ranks by dps (casters unranked).

## Training data (addon)
`addon/RoadToForever/TrainingData.lua` is generated by `addon/tools/gen_training_data.py` from Wowhead Forever's ability lists (trainer-sold spells with level, rank and list price). Wowhead blocks plain downloads, so the script's docstring has a browser console snippet that saves `wh_all.json`; run the script on it. Not part of `build.py` (needs a browser). Refresh before launch and after Forever patches.

## Talent builds from RankedBoost (builds.html share codes)
`python addon/tools/builds_from_rankedboost.py` (dry run) / `--apply` rewrites the `code:` and the fallback `talents: t30([...])` rows of the
mapped builds from RankedBoost's recommended builds: each class page embeds a JSON `builds` list whose `alloc` is {Wowhead talent id: rank}.
Ids convert exactly through `gen_talent_data.py`'s live fetch; ranks are capped at the live maximum (RankedBoost lags hotfixes); level 30 =
first 21 points in the calculator's order; an illegal result is kept and reported. Extend `MAP` in the script when builds.html gains a build.
After `--apply`: `python addon/tools/gen_talent_data.py`, `python build.py`, `python addon/tests/run_tests.py`; the `rotation` text is NOT
rewritten (BACKLOG). The 0.84.2 result is reproduced exactly (0 changes on a dry run).

## Macro spell names
`python addon/tools/check_macro_spells.py` (run by `build.py`, warnings only) compares every `/cast` and `/use` name in `data.py` with
TrainingData.lua + TalentData.lua per class. `ALLOWED` = real spells outside both lists (stances, forms, pet and quest spells);
`OPEN` = names known not to be in the current data, listed every run until confirmed in the live game.
